text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Compulsory Education (National Primary Schools) Regulations 2018 and come into operation on 2 January 2019.
2. For the purpose of paragraph (d) of the definition of “national primary school” in section 2 of the Act, the organisations specified in the Schedule are national primary schools.
